project_info.theme: Stillness in a rushing crowd taco campaign
project_info.color_palette: black, dark earth tones, warm yellow, natural taco colors

main_subject.detail: Adult man in a black hoodie remains perfectly sharp and still while calmly eating one taco and holding a paper tray of three tacos.
main_subject.style: cinematic commercial photography with natural skin texture

composition_elements.layout: medium portrait with sharp subject centered against horizontally motion-blurred crowd
composition_elements.text: While They at top, massive yellow RUSH centered behind, white serif We make and You seen flanking the subject.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: warm gridded key at 4300K with soft front fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: cinematic contrast, warm face highlights and blurred rushing environment

technical_specs.render_style: Sony A7 IV, FE 50mm f/1.4, commercial food photography
technical_specs.optics: sharp subject, controlled long-exposure crowd streaks and restrained grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Medium shot of an adult man in a black hoodie, perfectly still and sharp, calmly eating a taco while holding a paper tray of three tacos. The background is a heavily motion-blurred crowd creating horizontal chaotic streaks in dark earth tones. Overlay text features: small yellow "While They" at the top, a massive bold yellow "RUSH" with heavy motion blur in the center, and white serif italics "We make" and "You seen" flanking the subject. Professional commercial photography, cinematic lighting, high contrast between the still subject and the rushing environment.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, malformed tacos, unreadable text, motion blur on subject
